cut: Doodle 7, VIRAL CUT, stills checkpoint (25 Oct). The Muhos site from Count the Trees, already cleared; LVV's request to the police lands on it as a sealed folder; why? secret; the stream beside the site turns rust-brown on 'acidification'; punch: the reasons are secret, the water is everyone's. Loops to frame 0's framing.
argument: Finland's licensing authority asked the police to investigate Doodle's Muhos data-centre site, keeps its reasons secret, and has seen signs of acidification in the water nearby.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Muhos, Finland: / the authority / asked police to / [investigate].
text.ja: フィンランド・ムホス： / 当局が 警察に / [捜査を] 要請。

captions.source: LVV (Finland's licensing and supervisory agency) has filed a request with the police to investigate Doodle's (Google's) Muhos data-centre project, and says the matter is secret under the Publicity Act, so it will not comment further (Kaleva/STT ~22 Oct 2026, https://www.kaleva.fi/lvv-on-tehnyt-poliisille-tutkintapyynnon-googlen-m/13720712 ; Maaseudun Tulevaisuus, https://www.maaseuduntulevaisuus.fi/uutiset/656d00a6-6a46-4479-a214-0a73c03a8ee2 ; Yle, https://yle.fi/a/74-20252848). Search summaries only; originals not opened. The caption says only that the authority ASKED: Yle quotes the police saying no preliminary inquiry has started, Kaleva/IL earlier said one had (on a private person's request), so the film claims neither.

text.ja: 理由は？ / 詳細は / [非公開]。

captions.source: LVV says the matter is secret under the Publicity Act and will not comment (Kaleva/STT, Yle, ~22 Oct 2026; search summaries). Paraphrase, no quote marks.

text.en: Water by the site: / signs of / [acidification].
text.ja: 現場の そばの 水に / [酸性化の] / 兆候。

captions.source: LVV: monitoring results supplied by Doodle's Finnish subsidiary show changes pointing to acidification in the Muhos data-centre area, which lies in the influence zone of a black-shale deposit; Doodle must submit a detailed water plan by 5 Nov 2026, and a fine may follow (Kaleva/STT, MT, Yle ~22 Oct; search summaries). The film draws the stream beside the site rust-brown as an illustration, not a measurement; which water was sampled is not stated on screen.

text.ja: 理由は 非公開。 / 水は / [みんなの もの]。

captions.source: The station's own line, drawn from the two facts above: LVV's reasons are secret; the water in question is public (a stream/ground water is not anyone's trade secret). Opinion, framed as the punchline.

post.en: New in Muhos, Finland: the authority itself has asked the police to investigate Doodle's data-centre site. Its reasons are secret. It found signs of acidification in the water nearby and wants a water plan by 5 Nov. The reasons: secret. The water: everyone's. Whose secret is it?
post.fi: Uutta Muhokselta: LVV itse pyysi poliisia tutkimaan Doodlen datakeskustyömaan. Perusteet ovat salaisia. Lähivesissä on merkkejä happamoitumisesta, ja vesisuunnitelma vaaditaan 5.11. mennessä. Perusteet: salaisia. Vesi: kaikkien. Kenen salaisuus se on?
